notes:
REF-BM-02: Metadata lookup collects title and description only after an explicit action; favicon and preview image are missing.
REF-BM-07: List items show title, description, and tags but no favicon.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry provides no autocomplete for existing tags.
REF-BM-11: Displayed tag chips cannot be selected to filter the list.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action interface.
REF-BM-21: Actions cannot be applied to the entire currently filtered collection.
REF-BM-22: No selectable sort keys or sorting controls are implemented.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be written and displayed, but markdown is escaped and rendered as plain text.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML snapshot or PDF preservation exists.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is not implemented.
REF-BM-29: Saved search/tag bundles are not implemented.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is not implemented.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is not implemented.
REF-BM-32: Display-related personal settings are not implemented.
